posts.author: ZB3000
posts.body:
Hi! I'm new to the community, but I've been creating stuff since RPG Maker 2. After a couple years of playing around on the PS4 version of RPG Maker MV, I finally decided to take the plunge and get both MV and MZ on the PC while it was still on sale.
Anyways, what I'm looking for is a template for an SV battler where the character is in a wheelchair. I'm working on a game where one of the main characters is in a wheelchair, and I'm only missing the battler sprites (technically... Avery's wheelchair character sprites keep getting flagged as unsafe to download for whatever reason).
I would prefer to stay close to the RTP style, but I will work with whatever anyone has to offer.
Thank you!
